articles.title: Daniel Cormier REACTS to Arman Tsarukyan CRAZY KO vs. Ruffy, Sharaf KOs Gable, Joshua Van-Pantoja
articles.description: Joshua Van, Alexandre Pantoja, Arman Tsarukyan, and Mauricio Ruffy headlined one of the UFC cards of the year, and Daniel Cormier IS BACK with his reaction to UFC 331 in Los Angeles! Van and Pantoja had put on a show in the main event, with Van winning the rematch by unanimous decision in defense of his flyweight title. articles.description: Was Joshua Van’s win over Alexandre Pantoja really a fluke? Chael Sonnen breaks down the story surrounding a potential Pantoja vs. Van rematch—and why the timing could matter just as much as the result. Pantoja has reportedly grown frustrated with the idea of Joshua Van calling himself champion, but Van has taken a very different approach, openly acknowledging that he believes he needs to beat Pantoja again for it to truly mean something. That sets up a fascinating question: who was actually better that night? Chael also examines the biggest variable heading into another fight—the injury Pantoja suffered and how long he has had to recover. If Pantoja only returned to training relatively recently, could that affect how prepared he is when the rematch finally happens? The first fight may be history, but the rematch could settle the argument once and for all. #UFC #MMA #JoshuaVan #AlexandrePantoja #Pantoja #ChaelSonnen #UFCFlyweight #UFCNews #UFCChampionship
